import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [1, 5, 8, 2],
    "b": [2, 6, 9, 1],
})


def classify(row: tuple) -> str:
    a, b = row
    return "hi" if a + b > 10 else "lo"


result = df.with_columns(
    pl.Series(
        "label",
        df.select("a", "b").map_rows(classify)["map"],
    )
)

print(result)
